[[File:Entrenching_Tool.png|thumb|right|250px|An entrenching tool]]
An '''entrenching tool''' was a multipurpose device that could be used as a short shovel, a pickaxe, or an improvised hammer. Entrenching tools were employed by [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] for thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. In a pinch, one could use the durable tool as an unbalanced but effective weapon. One typically cost around fifty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and weighed about a [[Kilogram/Legends|kilogram]].
